ns2:section.sectionText: For more information, visit https://publish.illinois.edu/nutrition-fshn120/consider120/. If you have any course related questions, feel free to contact Toni Burkhalter at burkhalt@Illinois.edu or stop by her office at 499 Bevier Hall. If you would like to add the course but you get a 'course full' error message, go to www.fshn.illinois.edu and click on Undergraduate then Course Wait List. Wait lists will not open until one week before classes start in June. Until that time, please continue to check the status of this course to see if a seat has become available for you
